svg.title: StatsDiscordBot: Discord bot that gives feedback on statistics free-response homework
svg.desc: Students upload HTML answers in a class channel; the bot parses them, asks an LLM for feedback on English expression and statistical content, logs every attempt to SQLite and writes an HTML report that is synced to Google Drive. Used by about 150 students in statistics courses. Built with one teammate.

g.text: LLM feedback on English + stats content
every attempt, plus an HTML report
